messages:
clare_marketing: Heads-up: piloting a compact pricing strip + mini-cost-calculator next Monday. Objective: clearer labels, fewer billing FAQ clicks, and smarter lead routing from calc.

dan_growth: Nice. Primary KPI?

clare_marketing: demo CTA CTR (baseline 1.9% -> target 2.9%). Secondary: calc_use_rate and SQLs from pricing page.

rex_product: Naming idea: "Starter" / "Team" / "Committed" with one-line clarifiers. Avoid Pro/Enterprise.

zoe_design: I'll push two variants: (A) inline compact strip + mini calc, (B) strip + sticky calc. Mobile-first.

hannah_eng: mini-calc is simple: tokens_per_month * price_per_1k_by_tier + optional private fee. We'll emit events: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_input, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_calc_priority.

mark_sales: Routing: if tier=Committed AND priority_checkbox checked -> create SFDC lead with tag=pricing_calc_committed and lead_score=65. Include est_monthly_usd and utm. Also ping #sales-enterprise.

ada_cs: I'll draft a 2-line FAQ snippet for the strip and short support reply templates.

clare_marketing: A/B split 50/50. Run 3 weeks or 6k visits. Tracking: dan add demo_click, calc_use, calc_submit, calc_tier_committed, calc_priority.

ci_bot: Reminder: Experiment "pricing-clarity-mini-calc" scheduled for 2026-10-05 07:00 UTC. CI window 05:00-07:00 UTC.

zoe_design: I'll drop mocks by Thursday EOD. clare, please confirm final label copy.

clare_marketing: Confirming: Starter (trial), Team (shared capacity), Committed (SLA & private options). Action items: zoe designs, hannah events + webhook, dan tracking, ada support copy, mark sfdc mapping. Reconvene day-before-launch for smoke test. :rocket:
